name: shopify-geo-monorepo
description: Shopify AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) & GEO Platform Monorepo

scripts.build: npx tsc -p packages/shared-types && npx tsc -p packages/core-engine && npx tsc -p packages/shopify-app
scripts.geo:audit: npm run build && node packages/core-engine/dist/cli/geo-cli.js audit
scripts.geo:sync: npm run build && node packages/core-engine/dist/cli/geo-cli.js sync
scripts.geo:all: npm run geo:audit && npm run geo:sync
